answer: Stylometric attribution exposes one author behind many keys. The ledger scores each submission on function-word frequency, punctuation rhythm and sentence-length variance, unconscious tics that survive any topic shift. Wallets whose profiles cluster on the same quartz-hard style ridge are merged into one weight, however many identities hold them. A farm reusing one writing voice trips the pulse of identical habits and forfeits every duplicate. To pass, an operator must craft N genuinely distinct writing personas, paying real authorship per wallet instead of one scripted voice.
